P['embed.W'][52, 0] = 1.0
P['embed.b'][0] = -2.5
# Feature 1: relu(2.5 - car_x) -> positive when car is left of threshold
P['embed.W'][52, 1] = -1.0
P['embed.b'][1] = 2.5

# Pass these two features cleanly through all 5 tanh layers
for k in range(5):
    Wk = P[f'actor{k}.W']
    bk = P[f'actor{k}.b']
    Wk[0, :] = 0; Wk[0, 0] = 1.0
    Wk[1, :] = 0; Wk[1, 1] = 1.0
    Wk[:, 0] = 0; Wk[0, 0] = 1.0
